title: Add AGENTS.md with cloud-specific development instructions
body: Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud specific development instructions for future agents working on this codebase. ## What's included - Service overview table (Next.js dev server, Python utilities) - Lint/build/dev commands - Environment variable setup notes - Key caveats (npm lockfile, pre-cached tiles, legacy `app/` directory, Python scripts) ## Dev environment verification The full development environment was verified: - `npm install` in `webapp/` - `npm run lint` — 0 errors, 3 warnings - `npm run build` — successful - `npm run dev` — server starts on port 3000 - Map viewer loads and is fully interactive (polygon clicks, layer switching, menu) ![Map loaded with satellite imagery and colored polygon overlays](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-9b401671-6a80-41e7-bfc5-53f5736b824c) ![Popup showing sound class info for a polygon zone](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-75246fc2-0e9e-4e26-b7c9-3e7a5e90cf30)
